instruction: Purge all cookies saved by Amazon so that the website won't remember my previous visits.

metadata.explanation: Task requires purging Amazon cookies to prevent website from remembering visits. Uses existing is_cookie_deleted metric to verify .amazon.com cookies are removed.
metadata.verification: The is_cookie_deleted function checks if any cookie domain matches .amazon.com. Returns 1.0 if no Amazon cookies found, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts all cookies from Chrome's SQLite database across different OS platforms
Metric logic properly checks if any Amazon domain cookies remain, returning 1.0 if none found and 0.0 if any found
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure fresh cookie state verification, which is necessary for accurate checking
Expected domain '.amazon.com' is semantically correct for matching Amazon cookies including subdomains
Evaluator can successfully verify whether Amazon cookies have been purged from the browser
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding 'amazon.com' (without leading dot) to the domains list to cover edge cases where cookies might be stored with exact domain match instead of subdomain wildcard
The compare_urls function at chrome.py:438 is being used for domain comparison - verify this function handles domain-only strings correctly (not just full URLs with protocols/paths)
